name: Dishwasher
definition: A household automatic dishwasher that uses heated water and detergent to clean tableware held in racks by pumped spray through one or more spray devices, followed by draining and a model-specific drying process.
includedScope: Built-in and freestanding household automatic dishwashers
Models with racks, sump, circulation pump and spray system
excludedScope: Commercial flight, rack-conveyor and hood-type dishwashers
Manual sink washing and countertop ultrasonic cleaners
Unverified rack, pump, filter, hose or control-board compatibility
primaryApplications: Household tableware and cookware washing within rack and cycle limits
Model-approved glassware, intensive and economy cycles
headline: Dishwasher spray systems, racks, filtration, drying and buyer checks
description: This profile separates racks, dosing, water heating, sump filtration, circulation, spray coverage, drainage, drying and leak protection so buyers can verify exact dishwasher fit and service requirements.
metaDescription: Dishwasher guide covering racks, pumps, spray arms, filtration, drying, models, standards and buyer checks.
disclaimer: This independent category reference is not plumbing, electrical, chemical, food-safety or installation advice. Confirm the exact regional model, manual, cabinet opening, supply, drain, detergent, tableware, cycle, rack and service-part numbers.

keyFacts.label: Category boundary
keyFacts.value: Household rack-loaded automatic washer using heated water and pumped spray
keyFacts.evidence: IEC standards and manufacturer pages define household dishwasher performance, safety and rack-and-spray product systems.
keyFacts.scope: Household automatic dishwashers; commercial warewashing excluded.

keyFacts.label: Buyer verification
keyFacts.value: Match cabinet, utilities, rack geometry, cycle, filter and service parts to exact model
keyFacts.evidence: Official model sources publish differing dimensions, place-setting, spray, drying and installation configurations.

systemFlow.name: Fill, heat and dose
systemFlow.componentFamily: Inlet valve, safety float, heater, detergent and rinse-aid dispensers
systemFlow.role: Admits and conditions water and releases approved chemistry.
systemFlow.evidence: Official specifications identify hidden heaters, dispensers and safety controls by model.

systemFlow.name: Recirculate and spray
systemFlow.componentFamily: Sump, filter, circulation pump, manifold and spray arms
systemFlow.role: Filters and repeatedly sprays wash liquid across loaded racks.
systemFlow.evidence: Manufacturer pages document model-specific wash arms, pumps and filtration.
systemFlow.scope: Approved loading and maintained filter system.

systemFlow.name: Drain and dry
systemFlow.componentFamily: Drain pump, hose, heat or condensation path, fan or automatic door where fitted
systemFlow.role: Removes wash liquid and applies the selected drying process.
systemFlow.evidence: Official pages distinguish heated, condensation and auto-open drying functions.

variants.name: Built-in dishwasher
variants.operatorRelationship: User loads racks, doses chemistry and starts a cycle
variants.spaceConstraints: Cabinet opening, door swing, toe kick, supply, drain and anchoring
variants.limitations: Nominal width does not establish cabinet or panel fit.
variants.evidence: Bosch, LG, Samsung and Whirlpool publish built-in models.

variants.name: Freestanding dishwasher
variants.taskScale: Household installation with finished external panels
variants.operatorRelationship: User loads and operates a complete freestanding cabinet
variants.spaceConstraints: Floor footprint, counter clearance, hoses and door swing
variants.limitations: Freestanding does not mean portable or installation-free.
variants.evidence: Beko and Electrolux publish freestanding product configurations in selected markets.

performanceMetrics.name: Cleaning and drying performance
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: Result under a defined load, soil, detergent, cycle and assessment method
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Test method, cycle duration, loading and drying definition must match
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Feature names or maximum temperature do not establish the test result.
performanceMetrics.evidence: IEC 60436 defines measurement methods while manufacturers publish model programs.

performanceMetrics.name: Capacity and rack fit
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: Source-declared place settings and usable loading geometry
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Place-setting conventions do not represent every pot, bottle or regional tableware set
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: A larger setting count can still have poorer task fit.
performanceMetrics.evidence: Official pages publish model-specific rack layouts and setting counts.
performanceMetrics.scope: Exact racks and declared loading method.

performanceMetrics.name: Water, energy and sound
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: Resource demand and source-declared operating noise under specified programs
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Program, test method, installation and market label differ
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Do not compare annual, per-cycle and maximum figures as equivalent.
performanceMetrics.evidence: Official model specifications publish qualified energy, water and dBA data.
performanceMetrics.scope: Exact model and regional test basis.

applicationFit.wcbAssessment: Trial actual plates, bowls, glasses and utensils in the delivered racks.
applicationFit.assessment: Trial actual plates, bowls, glasses and utensils in the delivered racks.
applicationFit.basis: Rack geometry, spray shadowing, soil, detergent and cycle interact.
applicationFit.limitations: Place settings and spray-arm count do not guarantee fit or cleaning.
applicationFit.buyerAction: Record loading time, blocked items, cleaning, drying and unloading condition.
applicationFit.evidence: Official sources document model-specific racks and wash systems.

applicationFit.wcbAssessment: Verify the full opening, services, anchoring and open-door envelope.
applicationFit.assessment: Verify the full opening, services, anchoring and open-door envelope.
applicationFit.basis: Cabinet depth, panel, hinge, hose and service routing determine fit.
applicationFit.limitations: 24-inch or 60-cm labels do not establish interchangeability.
applicationFit.buyerAction: Attach measured site drawings and the exact installation sheet to the order.
applicationFit.evidence: Manufacturer instructions provide model-specific dimensions and utility requirements.

componentStack.name: Inlet, heating and dosing
componentStack.role: Admits water, heats where configured and meters cleaning chemistry.
componentStack.evidence: Official pages show model-specific water and chemistry arrangements.
componentStack.scope: Exact model and market; no cross-model fit.

componentStack.name: Sump, filter, pump and spray system
componentStack.role: Recirculates filtered wash liquid across the racks.
variants: Two-, three- or four-device spray layouts
componentStack.evidence: Manufacturers publish materially different circulation and spray architectures.

componentStack.name: Racks, drain and drying
componentStack.role: Positions the load, removes liquid and completes model-specific drying.
componentStack.evidence: Official model pages distinguish rack and drying systems.

representativeModels.evidence: Bosch publishes the exact model and features.
LG publishes the exact 2026 model specification sheet.
Samsung publishes the named model and features.
Miele publishes the named model and features.

procurementDecisions.intendedTask: Clean and dry actual household tableware
procurementDecisions.attributeToVerify: Rack fit, spray access, cycle result and drying
procurementDecisions.comparisonTrap: Ranking by place settings, spray count or dBA alone
procurementDecisions.assessment: Use matched witnessed loads with documented chemistry and cycle.
procurementDecisions.basis: Loading, soil, water, detergent, spray and drying interact.
procurementDecisions.limitations: Catalogue metrics do not establish achieved result.
procurementDecisions.buyerAction: Compare loading work, rejects, residual water, time and resource use.
procurementDecisions.evidence: IEC and official sources expose different performance boundaries.

procurementDecisions.attributeToVerify: Cabinet, hoses, pump, filter, racks, heater and controls
procurementDecisions.comparisonTrap: Assuming a common width or family label proves interchangeability
procurementDecisions.assessment: Quote the complete exact-model installation and service package.
procurementDecisions.basis: Connections, hinges and component codes vary.
procurementDecisions.limitations: Future part availability is not guaranteed.
procurementDecisions.buyerAction: Obtain site drawing and five-year part codes, prices and lead times.
procurementDecisions.evidence: Official installation and product records are model-specific.

engineeringChecks.check: Electrical, water, drain and cabinet installation
engineeringChecks.reason: Incorrect utilities, anchoring or hose routing can create leak, heat and safety risks.
engineeringChecks.buyerAction: Follow the exact installation instructions and local requirements.
engineeringChecks.evidence: IEC safety scope and manufacturer documents define exact-product requirements.

engineeringChecks.reason: Blocked filters or spray paths can alter circulation and cleaning.
engineeringChecks.buyerAction: Inspect loading clearance and follow the exact filter and spray-arm service schedule.
engineeringChecks.evidence: Official manuals and product materials define model-specific maintenance.

standards.name: IEC 60436:2015
standards.applicability: Methods for measuring performance of household electric dishwashers.
standards.evidence: IEC publishes the standard scope and edition.
standards.scope: Confirm regional adoption and declared test method.

standards.name: IEC 60335-2-5:2025
standards.applicability: Particular safety requirements for household dishwashers.
standards.evidence: IEC publishes the standard scope and current edition.
standards.scope: Confirm regional conformity for the exact product.

developments.title: Current dishwasher platforms add more model-specific spray and drying formats
developments.summary: Reviewed current official ranges include multi-arm washing, third racks, heated, condensation or automatic-door drying in different combinations.
developments.evidence: Official product pages document the named functions without establishing equal performance.
developments.scope: Named products available at verification time.
